convert_model_to_MOLE_model: convert a PyTorch model to a MOLE model by replacing linear layers with MOLE expert layers
replace_linear_with_MOLE: replace an existing linear module with a MOLE or MOLEDGL expert layer using global tensors
recursive_replace_so2_linear: recursively replace all fc_m0 and SO2 convolution fc linear layers within SO2_Convolution modules
recursive_replace_all_linear: recursively replace all torch.nn.Linear layers in a model with a custom replacement factory
model_search_and_replace: search and replace modules in specific model blocks using a provided search function and replacement factory
